instruction: Open the registration page for the MileagePlus frequent flyer program.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to MileagePlus enrollment page. Similar complexity to original baggage calculator task - single navigation. Uses pattern matching to verify both 'united.com' domain and 'mileageplus' keyword in URL. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both 'united.com' domain and 'mileageplus' keyword in URL, which correctly verifies navigation to MileagePlus enrollment page
Correct getter logic: active_tab_info getter extracts URL from accessibility tree and navigates to verify page is accessible
Correct metric logic: is_expected_url_pattern_match performs regex search for both patterns and requires all patterns to match
Proper data flow: Getter returns dict with 'url' field, metric correctly handles both string and dict formats (chrome.py:79-87)
Semantically correct expected values: Patterns 'united.com' and 'mileageplus' accurately represent the target enrollment page
Flexible pattern matching: Regex search allows for various URL structures (/mileageplus/enroll, /en/mileageplus, etc.)
No state timing issues: Getter reopens the page to verify current state
